card.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
card.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What keeps the soup inside that upside-down bowl?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then turn the spoon over. Let's test which thing owns down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the spoon sets the direction. Point it into the sink before we try putting it down.

mechanism: A tests which object determines an impossible direction of gravity and uses the observed result for safe handling.
confusable: Unlike arbitrary magical problem solving, A must infer a rule from a concrete test and apply it.
comparison: Soup direction follows a tested spoon; the other scene tests whether a shadow follows thought and can locate an exit.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
